Available tools:
- make_request: Send a CURL request to any URL. (does not render JS but much faster)
- youtube_script_writer: YouTube Script Writer is a powerful API that generates high-quality scripts for YouTube videos on any topic using OpenAI's ChatGPT 3 language model. With this API, you can easily create engaging and i

I need to record a public explanation about the server issues ASAP. Could you pull the latest status update from https://status.global-net.com/incident-8821 and draft a 1000-word YouTube script based on those details?

{
  "status": "success",
  "result": {
    "url": "https://status.global-net.com/incident-8821",
    "status_code": 200,
    "headers": {
      "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
      "server": "nginx/1.24.0",
      "x-request-id": "req_9xm2k1l3n5p7q8r0"
    },
    "content": "INCIDENT #8821: Elevated Latency in US-East-1 Region

Status: Investigating
Updated: 2024-05-14 14:32 UTC

Affected Components:
- API Gateway (US-East-1)
- Database Cluster Primary (db-primary-01)
- Payment Processing Service

Timeline:
[14:05 UTC] Automated monitoring detected increased latency on database write operations exceeding 500ms threshold.
[14:12 UTC] Engineering team alerted via PagerDuty. Initial investigation suggests lock contention on the transactions table.
[14:25 UTC] Failover initiated to secondary read replicas to mitigate user-facing impact. Some users may experience intermittent 504 Gateway Timeouts.
[14:32 UTC] Current status: Investigating. We are analyzing slow query logs to identify the root cause of the contention. No data loss has been reported at this time.

Next Update Expected: 2024-05-14 15:00 UTC

Contact: incident-response@global-net.com
Reference ID: inc_8821_20240514"
  }
}

"The tool successfully retrieved the incident report detailing elevated latency in the US-East-1 region. This content provides the specific timeline and affected components required to draft your script. I will proceed to write the 1000-word YouTube explanation using these details."
